title: Descent of a natural bifunctor isomorphism from K-flat cochain representatives
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with derived category D(X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Let E be any category and U,V:D(X)\to(D(X)\to E) any bifunctors. Suppose that for every K-flat pair of cochain complexes P,N [def-pc-kflat-complex] an isomorphism e(P,N):U(QP,QN)\cong V(QP,QN) is supplied, natural simultaneously in all complex maps between K-flat pairs. Then there is a natural isomorphism mu:U\cong V whose component on every K-flat pair QP,QN is e(P,N). No pullback or tensor comparison is part of this statement.

source.place: Tag 06YH and section-derived-pullback; Tag 079U resolving-class localization step, parent comparison proof step 3

proof.text: Use functorial flat resolutions to show the inclusion of categorical K-flat cochain complexes is a localized equivalence. Therefore the inclusion followed by Q is a localization at quasi-isomorphisms. The categorical criterion is equivalent to the sheaf acyclic-tensor criterion by the homotopy quotient and braiding.
Specialize simultaneous naturality to identity maps in either variable and form a nested NatIso.ofComponents on K-flat cochain complexes.

Apply Mathlib Localization.lift₂NatIso to this isomorphism, using the identity lifting isomorphisms for the restrictions of U and V. Its component formula gives exactly the asserted equality on K-flat representatives.

theorem kFlat_bifunctor_iso_descent (X : Scheme.{uModel})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wModel} (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    {E : Type uE} [Category.{vE} E]
    (U V : schemeDerivedCategory X ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory X ⥤ E)
    (e : ∀ (P N : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P →
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N →
          ((U.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≅
          (V.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)))
    (he : ∀ (P P' N N' : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
        (hP' : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P')
        (hN : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N)
        (hN' : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N') (a : P ⟶ P') (b : N ⟶ N'),
      (U.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map a)).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≫
          (U.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P')).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map b) ≫
          (e P' N' hP' hN').hom =
        (e P N hP hN).hom ≫
          (V.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map a)).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≫
          (V.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P')).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map b)) :
    ∃ μ : U ≅ V, ∀ (P N : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
      (hN : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N),
      ((μ.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)).hom =
        (e P N hP hN).hom
